applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Existing CDiscount authorizations remain in service. New authorizations are temporarily unavailable under the current service notice; new stores use manual sales-record uploads.

The CDiscount connection uses platform-side authorization. The CDiscount and CedarPay registration entities must match. A successful historical connection does not establish that a new connection request will be accepted while new authorizations are unavailable.

For a new store, complete the store information and use the manual record-submission route. Contact support if the upload entry is unavailable. This notice remains applicable until replaced by a dated service update.
